title: Coached a SaaS team on reusable CI workflows
summary: After four design sessions with SaaS developers on reusable CI workflows, the project lead asked me to run weekly pair reviews with the team and to share the approach as a best practice.
what_would_have_happened: Each SaaS team would design its CI pipelines from scratch.
the_call: Coach the developers through the design by pairing with them, and let them build the workflows.
what_i_did: Held four design discussions on the Java workflow flavor, then weekly pair reviews with the developers.
what_changed: The project lead made the pair reviews a weekly practice and suggested I share the approach as a best practice for SaaS teams.

quotes.text: Thank you for all the time you have given us so far. We have thoroughly enjoyed the learning.
